reviews.comment: This has been my favorite professor by far. She is extremely caring and loves what she does. Her class is pretty difficult and very essay heavy but she is super good at helping you succeed. If you are actually interested in what she teaches, I would highly recommend her to be your professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very engaging and understanding of personal situations. Big on attendance and participation in class discussions. Participation is worth 20% of your grade, and the rest is based on two exams and two essays.

I truly loved her class. She pushes you to become a better writer, and I really appreciated that—even during the moments when I felt I deserved a better grade. As a university student, I don't expect grades to be handed to me; in this class, you had to earn your grade. I was happy to pass with a B+. She does require you to read and participate.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class was pretty intense, especially if you do not have a lot of knowledge on the subject beforehand. The grading did seem fair, it was just a little difficult.

Gave good lectures, encouraged discussion in class and would not disparage you if you did not know what you were talking about. Available outside of class and gives great feedback on exams and papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Reddy is an amazing professor. While the readings were at times difficult to understand, her lectures were very insightful and helped bridge the gap. There weren't too many assignments, and she's a fair grader. You do have to be a strong writer, though. I feel like I learned a lot from her, and I look forward to taking one of her classes again!

Professor Reddy was a very good professor, however she was a very tough grader. She was not very helpful at explaining really complex theories and she would treat an entry level undergrad class like grad school. Most of the people in there were not even WGST majors or minors. Extremely confusing and demanding professor at times.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved the materials we read for class, but she was extremely unorganized. I know COVID is a consideration, but she went back on her word a lot with guidelines for the class and the lectures were very all over the place sometimes. It's doable, but I would have rathered take it with someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You get two freebie absences, AND SHE MEANS IT. 3 or 4 Position Papers, 2-3pages each. Reading assignments pretty often but most of the readings are interesting so don't worry. She is nice, helpful, funny, passionate. I would take her class again. I took her in spring of 2018 for Amer. Ethnic Lit. I feel like I learned so much. Buy the books.
Really like her she is very knowledgeable

Professor Reddy is a highly intellectual woman- I often didn't know what she was talking about. This class was literally all about racism in America, not really American lit. Her tests are passable if you regurgitate her lecture slides. There's a ton of reading but not much writing. She's doable but I would take something else if you have options.

Professor Reddy was clearly passionate about the subject matter (gay and lesbian literature), but her lectures were almost too complex to fully grasp. She grades essays harshly whether they are in class essays (tests) or ones we did at home. It was an interesting class, but it could have been way better if it was easier to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class is all about racism and sexism in America. This class was very interesting to me. Prof Reddy is very passionate about her work & class was very interesting. You have about 1-2 quizzes a week over the readings. If you don't understand the book, it's okay because she goes in depth in class. She provides a review for every test so they are easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Reddy is a good professor and very passionate about what she does, however the class is a bit misleading in the course description and title. This class is based solely on the history of racism and sexism in America and focuses specifically on those aspects of history and nothing else. Sometimes boring class and you read a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is a great professor, who is very passionate about the lectures. Her class does require heavy reading and you must read before attending lecture. LECTURE IS VERY IMPORTANT. Her tests are easy if you answer the questions from the study guide and do the readings. PowerPoints suck. No essays are required in this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Reddy obviously loves English and is passionate about every lecture, but she is intense.  If you don't go to lecture, the tests will be way harder.  Her lectures are very wordy and I wish she would dumb down the ideas because there were a few times that I honestly had no idea what she was trying to say.  Not the most enjoyable class.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY
